target_customer: Marketing and brand teams at consumer brands that want to link social data to sales
problem: Brand managers lacked real-time measures of how social media activity affected sales and market share; brand value reports arrived too rarely to act on.
business_model: B2B SaaS analytics subscription and reports
product_category: Social data brand intelligence and sales forecasting

founders.name: Ayse Akcura
founders.background_notes: Listed on the YC page; background not found in an opened source.

founders.name: Tolga Akcura
founders.background_notes: YC page lists him as founder; search results describe him as a marketing professor, not opened.

competitors.name: Sprinklr
competitors.what: Social media management and listening platform

competitors.name: Interbrand and BrandZ
competitors.what: Periodic brand value rankings that VentureBeat framed as too infrequent to act on

technical_complexity.rationale: Ingesting social data from providers and fitting forecasting models against client sales data is standard data science with some modeling difficulty.

defensibility.rationale: Relies on third party social data and client sales data; the forecasting models were the main edge and listening vendors could add similar analytics.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No evidence found of an incumbent copying or buying it; the company stayed small and active.

market_need_then: Brands were spending heavily on social media in 2015 while struggling to tie it to sales; VentureBeat framed real-time sales impact as the gap.

identity.voice_and_tone: Analytical B2B; tagline uses a 'real-time Nielsen ratings for brands' comparison

branding.brand_signature: Real-time Nielsen ratings for brands tagline
branding.community_and_virality: Press limited to a VentureBeat profile and a Cannes Lions Lions Innovation finalist mention in Turkish tech press (Webrazzi, June 2015); no community or merch evidence.

brand_strength.rationale: Little brand coverage beyond a few press pieces; the camel case name is generic and easily confused with other brand value firms.

outcome_analysis: eBrandValue joined YC in Winter 2015 with a pitch of linking social data to sales, was a Cannes Lions innovation finalist in 2015, and still operates with named enterprise customers and an active blog in November 2026. No funding beyond a small unverified seed and no exit were found, so it looks like a small, steady B2B analytics company rather than a venture scale winner.
notes: Unverified funding: aggregators (CB Insights, Seedtable, Prospeo) show about $120K seed with Y Combinator dated February or April 2015; no press release found, so not recorded as a round. Founding year is 2012 per a VentureBeat snippet, other sources say 2013 or 2015. The Nielsen ScanTrack confirmation is a company claim. A 2024 revenue estimate of about $3M comes from an aggregator and is unverified. Competitor names come from a search summary of the VentureBeat article of February 2015; the article body was not opened directly.
